text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
When you run, you can feel the wind, right?
It feels so good, I catch total fever!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna blast off like a supercar,
so don't blink or you'll miss it☆

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
